title: SEPPA SSB-R12 Rotary PET Bottle Blowing Machine
overviewTitle: Overview of the SEPPA SSB-R12 Rotary PET Bottle Blowing Machine
overviewDescription: Rotary carousel architecture changed what a bottling line could ask of a single machine. The SEPPA SSB-R12 was built for plants that measure output in the hundreds of thousands of units per shift, not per day. It is a 12 cavity rotary platform designed around continuous motion synchronization, so preforms move through heating and forming stations without the stop start losses typical of linear systems.
overviewsubDescription: It is a rotary stretch blow molding operation performed on a revolving carousel instead of a stationary base. The rotary stretch blow molding ensures that all cavities go through their stages of heating, stretching and blowing without stopping the entire line in between for completing the process of one bottle formation. This is the only feature which distinguishes a true high speed PET blowing machine from a merely high speed machine.

SSB-R12 was designed by Seppa to ensure thermal and pressure stability in all twelve cavities, which is essential in mass production process due to rejection of bottles caused by any minor changes. Therefore, it became a specialized machine for mass scale beverage, water and industrial packaging plants where even minor stoppage may be devastating. That is why the high speed PET blowing machine has become the standard specification of so many plants now.

contentBlocks.title: Performance Benefits of the SEPPA SSB-R12 System
paragraphs: Plants running this high speed pet blowing machine report gains in Overall Equipment Effectiveness, mostly from fewer unplanned stoppages, since the rotary architecture removes single points of failure found in linear machines. When one cavity needs attention, the other eleven keep producing.

Energy costs drop too. The air recovery system reduces compressed air draw, and the servo driven carousel avoids the energy spikes associated with start stop linear motion. Over a full production year, that difference in energy per bottle adds up to a meaningful line item for high volume operations.

A high speed pet blowing machine is only as valuable as its uptime, and Seppa built the SSB-R12's maintenance access around that fact: thermal modules, blow valve assemblies, and seal housings are reachable without a full carousel teardown. That keeps scheduled maintenance windows short and predictable. Seppa holds the same blow machine plastic durability standard across its full PET equipment range, which is a large part of why plants running high uptime schedules with heavy stretch blow moulding demand keep coming back.

features.title: Rotary Carousel and Drive System
features.description: The SSB-R12 runs on a high torque rotary carousel driven by a servo system tuned for continuous duty operation. Mold clamping kinetics are engineered so clamp, stretch, and blow events land within tight timing windows across all cavities, cycle after cycle, without the carousel losing synchronization at full speed. Few linear machines hold that kind of timing at comparable output. That gap is part of why the term high speed pet blowing machine has become shorthand for rotary platforms like this one.

features.title: Multi Zone IR Thermal Modules
features.description: Preform conditioning happens across multi zone infrared modules positioned along the rotary path. Each zone is independently controlled, so wall thickness and material distribution stay consistent from the first preform of a shift to the ten thousandth. This is where a high speed pet blowing machine either earns its reputation or loses it: uneven heating shows up immediately as scrap.

features.title: Blow Valve Timing and Pneumatic Architecture
features.description: Valve timing of the SSB-R12 is controlled electronically, allowing Seppa's designers to accurately adjust stretch blow molding parameters according to the particular shape of the bottles without changing the valve drive. In combination with high pressure pneumatic system and air recovery line, it reduces the use of compressed air compared to those machines that release air at each cycle. A high speed pet blowing machine running 24/7 lives or dies on seal durability. Seppa uses high durability seals throughout the pneumatic and hydraulic circuits because seal failure is the single most common cause of unplanned downtime on rotary platforms. No blow machine plastic system hits its rated OEE if it's stopping every shift for seal replacement.

applicationsTitle: Applications Across Beverage, Water, and Packaging Industries
applicationsSubtitle: Seppa's rotary systems handle the volume swings across beverage categories.

applications.title: Water Bottling Plants
applications.description: Water bottling plants running still and mineral water lines need consistent wall thickness at high output, since thin spots show up as visible defects on clear PET. A high speed pet blowing machine tuned for water production prioritizes cycle stability over the pressure profiles used for carbonated products, and stretch blow moulding parameters shift accordingly between the two.

applications.title: Carbonated Soft Drink Lines
applications.description: Carbonated soft drink lines ask for something different: bottles that hold internal pressure without excess material, which means the stretch blow moulding parameters shift toward higher stretch ratios and tighter base design tolerances. The SSB-R12 handles both profiles through recipe based changeovers rather than mechanical rebuilds.

applications.title: Other Packaging Industries
applications.description: Beyond beverages, the blow machine plastic platform also serves personal care, household chemical, and edible oil packaging, where bottle geometries vary widely but round the clock output demands stay constant. Seppa's engineers set the specific stretch blow moulding profile a given container shape requires.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose Seppa Solutions for PET Blowing Machines
whyChoose.description: Seppa has spent years building rotary and linear stretch blow moulding equipment for bottling plants that cannot tolerate guesswork in production numbers.
paragraphs: Major beverage producers return to Seppa because the company designs each high speed pet blowing machine around the client's actual bottle range and output targets, not a generic spec sheet, and every high speed pet blowing machine ships with documentation matched to that specific configuration.

Seppa's engineering group supports full turnkey lines, not just the blow molding station, so preform handling, conveying, labelling, and filling integration are all considered from the start of a project. That end to end view is what lets a stretch blow moulding installation hit its rated speed on day one instead of after months of tuning.

Support doesn't stop at commissioning. Seppa provides ongoing technical service for every high speed pet blowing machine it installs, because a rotary platform running continuously needs a manufacturer that understands its own equipment. That commitment is also why a Seppa high speed pet blowing machine tends to stay in service years past its original warranty.

methodology.title: PET Bottle Blowing Machine Manufacturing Methodology
methodology.subtitle: The manufacturing sequence on the SSB-R12 starts with high speed preform feeding, where an orientation system loads preforms onto the carousel at the rate the line demands. From there, preforms pass through the IR thermal conditioning zones described above, where each cavity's heat profile is calibrated to the specific resin and wall geometry being run on this high speed pet blowing machine.

steps.title: High Speed Preform Feeding
steps.description: An orientation system loads preforms onto the carousel at the rate the line demands.

steps.title: IR Thermal Conditioning
steps.description: Preforms pass through the IR thermal conditioning zones, where each cavity's heat profile is calibrated to the specific resin and wall geometry being run on this high speed pet blowing machine.

steps.title: Synchronized Rotary Stretch Blow Moulding
steps.description: The synchronized rotary stretch blow moulding cycle follows: stretch rod extension, primary low pressure blow, then high pressure final blow, all timed to the carousel's rotation rather than to a fixed station clock.

steps.title: Automated Discharge
steps.description: Automated discharge removes finished bottles from the mold and transfers them to downstream conveying without manual intervention.

outro: Because the high speed pet blowing machine keeps every cavity moving through this sequence in parallel, throughput scales with cavity count instead of cycle time alone.
Seppa applies this feed to discharge sequence to every blow machine plastic unit it builds, whether the output bottle is 200 milliliters or several liters.

faqs.question: How often does a high speed pet blowing machine like the SSB-R12 need scheduled maintenance?
faqs.answer: Seal housings, blow valve assemblies, and IR modules on the SSB-R12 typically need inspection on a rolling schedule tied to cycle counts, since a machine running three shifts wears differently than one running a single shift.

faqs.question: How does the SSB-R12 maintain structural stability at high rotary speeds?
faqs.answer: The high torque carousel drive and precisely timed mold clamping keep each cavity's stretch blow moulding cycle synchronized, which prevents the vibration and misalignment that cause structural weak points in finished bottles.

faqs.question: Why do bottling plants choose Seppa for stretch blow moulding equipment?
faqs.answer: Plants cite consistent wall thickness across long runs, lower scrap rates from the multi zone thermal system, and Seppa's willingness to tune each machine to a specific bottle range instead of a fixed configuration.

faqs.question: What makes the SSB-R12's blow machine plastic architecture different from competing rotary systems?
faqs.answer: The combination of electronic blow valve timing, air recovery, and independently controlled thermal zones lets the SSB-R12 hold tolerances that mechanically timed systems struggle to match.

faqs.question: Why do global bottling operations trust Seppa Solutions for turnkey PET lines?
faqs.answer: Seppa's track record comes from designing complete lines around the client's product mix, then standing behind that equipment with direct technical support rather than handing off support to a third party.
